dedupe_keys.name: statistical tables of china high speed railway and japanese shinkansen lines and transfer stations

description: These statistical tables describe the operating lines and transfer stations of China's high-speed railway and Japan's Shinkansen as of the end of 2018. The first table lists each operating line with its transfer and terminal stations, and the second is a line-by-line matrix whose cells give the transfer stations between each pair of lines, so the tables can be turned into a line-level network. The data were collected from China's high-speed rail network information and from Baidu's Japan Shinkansen inquiry. They were deposited by Xiaoyan Gu and Kaihua Lu. Coverage is the national high-speed networks of China and Japan. Access: free download from 4TU.ResearchData under CC0 as a 40 KB ZIP (June 2019). Caveats: the tables are small, stop at 2018, and hold topology only, without distances, timetables or traffic. They support comparative network topology and robustness studies of high-speed rail systems at line level, and complement the Chinese high-speed railway operation dataset and the Japanese railway data catalogued here.
